name: for · Container and cgroup v2 resource diagnosis
syntax:
for name in cpu.max cpu.stat cpuset.cpus.effective cpuset.mems.effective              memory.current memory.max memory.events memory.pressure              io.stat pids.current pids.max; do
  f="${CGROUP_DIR:?Set verified cgroup v2 directory}/$name"
  if [ -r "$f" ]; then
    printf '\n%s\n' "$f"
    cat -- "$f"
  else
    printf 'UNAVAILABLE: %s\n' "$f" >&2
  fi
done
description: CGROUP_DIR must be the verified directory for that workload in the visible hierarchy.
